description: Resolve a stored audio blob CID to a playable URL. Exists because a blob CID is a content address, not a location: a client holding an embed's `audio.ref` needs somewhere to point an audio element.

main.description: Returns the playback URL for one blob within the caller's tenancy. The URL addresses this service's audio proxy, is stable, and carries no credential — so a response referencing it stays cacheable. It is NOT a direct storage URL and NOT time-limited.

cid.description: Content address of the audio blob, as carried on dev.antiphony.embed.audio#audio.

url.description: Playable audio URL, scoped to the caller's tenancy.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The CID does not form an addressable object for this tenancy.
